patterns: how much money do I have
responses: You can check your balance instantly via our Mobile Banking App, Net Banking portal, or by sending 'BAL' to our official SMS service number.

patterns: where can I find my account number
how to know my account number
responses: Your account number is available on the first page of your physical passbook, printed on your cheque book, and listed under your profile on our Mobile Banking app.
You can view and download e-statements (PDF format) under the 'e-Services / Statements' section in Net Banking or Mobile Banking.
To block your card immediately, open the Mobile Banking app and go to 'Cards' > 'Block Card', or call our toll-free customer emergency helpline at 1800-111-2222.

patterns: how to apply for debit card
responses: You can apply for a new Credit or Debit Card directly from our mobile app under the 'Cards' menu or by visiting your nearest branch.

patterns: what are the loan interest rates
how to apply for home loan
responses: We offer Home Loans starting at 8.4% p.a., Personal Loans starting at 10.5% p.a., and Education Loans. You can apply directly through the 'Loans' section on our portal.
Our bank branches operate from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM (Monday to Saturday), except on 2nd & 4th Saturdays and public holidays.
To reset your Net Banking password, click on 'Forgot Password/Username' on the login page and verify via OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
You can find your branch's 11-character IFSC code printed on your cheque book, passbook's front page, or by searching your branch name on our mobile banking app under 'Branch Locator'.
